arguments.content:
name: Release

# Runs when a maintainer pushes a version tag (vX.Y.Z) on the merge commit of a release pull request. See
# "Releases" in CONTRIBUTING.md. The job checks the tag, moves the major tag (vN), and creates a draft GitHub
# Release with the notes from the pull request. A maintainer reviews and publishes the draft.
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+']

permissions:
  contents: write # push the major tag, create the release
  pull-requests: read # read the release notes from the pull request

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # main and all tags

      - name: Check the tag
        run: |
          version="$(jq -r .version package.json)"
          if [ "$TAG" != "v$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag $TAG does not agree with version $version in package.json"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$(jq -r .version package-lock.json)" != "$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::package-lock.json does not have version $version. Use npm version $version --no-git-tag-version"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/main; then
            echo "::error::Tag $TAG is not on main. Tag the merge commit of the release pull request"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run quality checks
        run: npm run check

      - name: Move the major tag
        run: |
          major="${TAG%%.*}"
          latest="$(git tag --list "$major.*.*" --sort=-v:refname | head -n 1)"
          if [ "$latest" != "$TAG" ]; then
            echo "::notice::$latest is later than $TAG, so $major stays where it is"
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git tag --force --annotate "$major" --message "$major" "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git push --force origin "refs/tags/$major"

      - name: Create the draft release
        run: |
          # The "## Release notes" section of the pull request that merged this commit, up to the next "## ".
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$GITHUB_SHA/pulls" --jq '.[0].body // ""' \
            | tr -d '\r' \
            | awk '/^## Release notes[[:space:]]*$/ { found = 1; next } found && /^## / { exit } found' \
            > notes.md
          if ! grep -q '[^[:space:]]' notes.md; then
            echo "::error::The pull request of $GITHUB_SHA has no \"## Release notes\" section"
            exit 1
          fi
          previous="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' "$GITHUB_SHA^" 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ -n "$previous" ]; then
            printf '\n**Full Changelog**: %s/%s/compare/%s...%s\n' \
              "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL" "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$previous" "$TAG" >> notes.md
          fi
          gh release create "$TAG" --draft --verify-tag --title "$TAG" --notes-file notes.md
          echo "::notice::Review and publish the draft: $(gh release view "$TAG" --json url --jq .url)"
